criteria.description: Primary shell and disclosure reach every documented state: desktop hover/click open-close, keyboard Enter/Space, Escape with focus return, outside/destination/mobile/breakpoint close, mobile activation-only panel; desktop dropdown opens upward from bottom-docked bar
Exactly one brand, four top entries (3 plain + 1 disclosure), three title-only destinations, one permanent action, one named toggle, one chevron — no duplicates or invented rich chrome
Desktop bottom-docked floating logo/up-control left / menu / one action; mobile top row brand+action+toggle with links below when open; upward desktop dropdown
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
